synopsis: Yoda introduce you to all the amazing planets, creatures, and aliens of a brick-built galaxy far, far away.Wonderful place, the galaxy is.Amazing planets and incredible aliens, you will find.Much to learn, you still have. Show you, I will....With Jedi Master Yoda as your tour guide, visit the incredible planets in the LEGO Star Wars galaxy. Meet brave heroes, villainous characters, and fascinating creatures - and learn all about the Star Wars galaxy along the way!
